sections.overview:
listiptv2020 is a marketing skill that provides IPTV stream data in M3U playlist format, featuring Vietnamese television channels including VTV1 with multiple stream sources. The skill contains structured broadcast information with channel logos, group classifications, and stream URLs designed for IPTV player compatibility. It serves as a reference implementation for managing and accessing live TV channel configurations.
Building IPTV player applications with Vietnamese TV channel support
Creating broadcast stream aggregation services
Developing media guide systems with channel metadata
Testing IPTV playlist parsing and stream delivery
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/trungss/listiptv2020`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a list of IPTV channels in the [COUNTRY] region for [INDUSTRY] companies. Include channel names, logos, and streaming URLs. Format the output as a valid M3U playlist file with #EXTM3U header and #EXTINF entries for each channel. Ensure the URLs are active and the logos are accessible.
```
Copy

```
```m3u8
#EXTM3U
#EXTINF:-1 tvg-logo="https://example.com/logo1.png" group-title="News",BBC News http://example.com/stream1.m3u8
#EXTINF:-1 tvg-logo="https://example.com/logo2.png" group-title="Sports",ESPN http://example.com/stream2.m3u8
#EXTINF:-1 tvg-logo="https://example.com/logo3.png" group-title="Entertainment",HBO http://example.com/stream3.m3u8
```
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
